panel.events.description: Event details, text styles and colours
color.follow_ha.card: Each calendar's colour in Home Assistant, where it holds one
color.custom.description: Any colour the card can draw: #e91e63, a CSS name, or a theme variable
color.invalid: Not a colour the card can draw
color.kept: Kept until the text above is a colour
split.row_helper: Turn this entry into two, such as all-day events and events with a time, each with its own colour.
split.how.intro: Two entries take this one’s place, each with its own colour. Both keep {name}’s other settings and read {entity}; nothing changes in Home Assistant.
entity.color.helper: Event titles from this calendar. Overrides the card colour.
entity.accent_color_mode.helper: Home Assistant’s colour under Settings, Devices & Services, Entities. Calendars without one fall back to the card.
entity.label_icon_color.helper: Left empty, the icon takes the text colour around it.
entity.event_type.helper: To give its all-day and timed events different colours, use Split This Calendar under Which Events.
time_grid.weekend_background_color.helpe: Any CSS colour; keep it faint, since event text sits on top. Weekend days follow the country set in Home Assistant.
time_grid.today_background_color.helper: Any CSS colour; keep it faint, since event text sits on top. On a weekend it replaces the weekend shading.
month.weekend_background_color.helper: Any CSS colour, or transparent for none; weekend days follow the country set in Home Assistant.
filter_duplicates_mode.helper: Hides an event that matches another on these fields. The copy from the entry listed first is kept, with its colour.
duplicate_accent_color.helper: For an event kept from two or more calendars. Left empty, it keeps the first calendar’s colour.
title.helper: Text with {{ or {% is a Home Assistant template. With the toolbar shown, the title’s size and colour apply to the month.
accent_event_text: Use Calendar Colours For Event Text
accent_event_text.helper: Draws each event’s title, time, location, description and progress bar in its calendar’s colour. Grid does this by default.
today_weekday_color.helper: Left empty, it falls back to the weekend colour on a weekend, then to the usual one.
today_day_color.helper: Left empty, the digits on the date tile take a deeper shade of the tile's colour.
accent_color_mode.helper: Home Assistant’s colour under Settings, Devices & Services, Entities. Calendars without one keep the card default.
accent_color_mode.option.custom.label: Custom colour
event_background_opacity.helper: Tints each event with its accent colour. Zero leaves it untinted.
allday_badge_style.helper: How much weight the badge carries, from a quiet wash to a solid block of colour.
allday_badge_color_mode.helper: The accent gives each calendar its own; the row text colour matches the row it sits on.
now_color.helper: The colour of an event that is happening right now, and of the now line in grid view.
